scope: Décor du labo et onze éléments transparents. Illustrations détaillées historiques conservées dans les fiches.

room.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production background for the interactive Kanab Quest transformation laboratory. Generate ONE empty dollhouse room, landscape 1200:850 composition.
Style: richly crafted French cartoon game illustration, clean irregular dark ink outlines, restrained hatch and print grain, cream stone and pale ceramic, petrol teal metal, warm apricot and mustard accents. Same charming illustrated Breton village universe as the established game. Believable clean small industrial laboratory, not a science fiction lab. No photorealism or glossy 3D.
Camera and geometry: orthographic axonometric, verticals remain vertical, floor axes run at exactly plus/minus 30 degrees from horizontal. Rear corner floor at x45%, y31%; right floor corner x84%, y63%; front floor corner x51.5%, y89%; left floor corner x12.5%, y57%. Rectangular usable room represents 6 metres wide by 5 metres deep. Only the TWO rear walls are visible, rising 2.7 metres vertically. Front walls and roof entirely removed. No perspective convergence. These floor coordinates are important because interactive machines will be overlaid in code using the same geometry.
Architecture: a refurbished Breton stone building fitted as a tidy hemp processing laboratory. Pale clean floor with unobtrusive seams, rear walls cream tile at lower height and cream stone above. Teal structural details. Restrained wall-mounted ventilation, a small utility sink and shallow wall shelves entirely along the upper wall perimeter. One normal 2-metre-high entrance door in the rear left wall, a small window high in the other wall, wall lights. Warm daylight. Precise clean architectural contours. Fine texture but quiet unobstructed floor.
Critical: the whole usable floor is EMPTY, absolutely no machines, furniture, tables, islands, crates, plants, characters or central objects. We will add separate purchased machines and empty footprint markers dynamically; do not bake in any equipment or workstations. Do not paint outlines for stations or labels. Surrounding canvas is warm pale cream, room sits fully within frame with margin, no rectangular card border, no headline, no text, logos, numbers, watermark or UI. This is a polished game environment, NOT a screen mockup.

sprites.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent game sprite atlas, eleven separate cutout laboratory assets for Kanab Quest.
References: Image 1 is the new laboratory background; use its exact illustrated ink-and-grain material style and axonometric camera. Image 2 is a comparison sheet: ONLY its LEFT COLUMN is the required machine identity and detailed construction reference; ignore its middle and right columns. Image 3 shows the six specific washer and press configurations we must keep recognizable.
Create a landscape 4-column by 3-row atlas, ideally 2048x1536, with exactly twelve equal square cells, ELEVEN objects and the last cell empty. Each object centered within its own cell, 12% clear transparent margin, complete silhouette, absolutely no overlap between cells, no painted grid. Objects may be individually sized to fill their cell; code will restore their real size. Every object views its front and RIGHT side, verticals straight, floor axes about 20 degrees, matching the lab's elevated orthographic camera. Do not view the tops straight down. Preserve realistic distinguishable machinery within hand-inked French cartoon art. Detailed gray stainless steel, petrol teal painted frames, cream trim, brass controls, subtle print texture, crisp outlines. No cute faces, no plants, no invented giant levers or glass chemistry apparatus.
Cell order is EXACT:
Row 1: (1) two low rectangular WOODEN MANUAL SIFT TRAYS stacked, metal mesh, like the left-column sift reference, no stand and no cylindrical motor; (2) COMPACT teal manual screw press, two small RECTANGULAR plates, top handwheel, tiny control unit, matching PRESS-0600; (3) MEDIUM teal hydraulic press with rectangular plates, gauge and side orange handwheel, matching PRESS-10T; (4) LARGE teal hydraulic workshop press, wide rectangular plates, tall central ram and side hydraulic pump unit, matching PRESS-20T. No tables below any press.
Row 2: (1) SMALL cream/teal cylindrical washer, lid open slightly, perforated basket, low drain hose and modest external mesh bag beside it, matching WASHER-25L; (2) PROFESSIONAL upright stainless steel rectangular washer on casters, digital control near top, outlet below, matching WASHER-75G; (3) LARGE TSS-225 multi-vessel stainless washing installation with THREE tanks, integrated platform and stair steps, railings and small control console, matching the reference; (4) stainless circular AUTOMATIC SIEVE collector with stacked rings, clear top guard and side motor, matching AUTO-SIEVE.
Row 3: (1) cream and dark teal FREEZE DRYER cabinet with open round chamber door and several visible horizontal trays, matching FREEZE-DRYER; (2) full-height STATIC SEPARATOR with two vertical transparent treatment cabinets in stainless frame and a compact adjacent teal air unit and small compressor at the base, matching STATIC-PLASMA, no theatrical lightning; (3) EMPTY clean stainless steel workbench, four straight legs, 120 cm wide, 70 cm deep, 90 cm high, same camera, with no objects, no lower shelf; (4) completely EMPTY transparent cell.
Every cell is a free-standing cutout on genuine transparency. Remove ALL cream-paper rectangles, radial background discs, ground, floor, shadows outside object edges, labels and text from the reference illustrations. No people, no badges, no words, no logos or watermarks. Actual transparent alpha background, not white or checkerboard. Keep all parts and natural object proportions; do not exaggerate small equipment.
sprites.packaging: Découpe mécanique des cellules, recadrage sur alpha > 16 avec 2 px transparents de marge, WebP q92 alpha100. Aucune retouche créative par code.

scale.limit: Projection calibrée sur le décor ; gabarits illustratifs pour les cotes absentes et les silhouettes fictives. Pas un plan de construction.
